arguments.command:
python -c "
import glom.core as core
import glom.reduction as reduction

# Get all classes that might be specifiers
specifier_classes = []
for name in dir(core):
    obj = getattr(core, name)
    if isinstance(obj, type) and hasattr(obj, 'glomit'):
        specifier_classes.append((name, obj))

for name, cls in sorted(specifier_classes):
    has_repr = '__repr__' in cls.__dict__  # Check if class defines its own __repr__
    print(f'{name}: has_own_repr={has_repr}')

print()
print('From reduction:')
for name in dir(reduction):
    obj = getattr(reduction, name)
    if isinstance(obj, type) and hasattr(obj, 'glomit'):
        has_repr = '__repr__' in obj.__dict__
        print(f'{name}: has_own_repr={has_repr}')
"
